## Summary
Build Conduit — a RealWorld-shaped blogging platform — as a greenfield monorepo: NestJS 11 + Prisma 6 (Postgres) JWT API, Angular 20 standalone SPA, served from a single container with an idempotent seed.

## Scope

### Files to modify
- `README.md` — replace stub with run/build/deploy instructions and the seeded credentials.

### Files to create

**Root / deploy**
- `Dockerfile` — 3-stage: build client → build server → slim runtime. Runtime `COPY`s `server/dist`, `server/node_modules`, `server/prisma`, and the Angular build into `server/public`.
- `.dockerignore`, `.gitignore`, `docker-compose.yml` (app + postgres:16 for local dev)
- `docker-entrypoint.sh` — `prisma migrate deploy` → `node dist/prisma/seed.js` → `node dist/main.js`
- `k8s/deployment.yaml`, `k8s/service.yaml`, `k8s/postgres.yaml`, `k8s/secret.example.yaml` — probes on `/api/health` (liveness) and `/api/health/deep` (readiness)

**Server (`server/`)**
- `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `nest-cli.json`, `.env.example`
- `prisma/schema.prisma` — the 7 models from the spec's Data Model
- `prisma/seed.ts` — idempotent `upsert` of jake + article + tags + comment
- `src/main.ts` — global `/api` prefix, `ValidationPipe({whitelist:true, transform:true})`
- `src/app.module.ts` — `ServeStaticModule` + feature modules
- `src/prisma/prisma.module.ts`, `prisma.service.ts`
- `src/health/health.controller.ts` — `/api/health`, `/api/health/deep`
- `src/auth/` — `auth.module.ts`, `auth.service.ts`, `auth.controller.ts`, `jwt.strategy.ts`, `jwt-auth.guard.ts`, `optional-jwt-auth.guard.ts`, `current-user.decorator.ts`, `dto/login.dto.ts`, `dto/register.dto.ts`, `dto/update-user.dto.ts`
- `src/profiles/` — `profiles.module.ts`, `.service.ts`, `.controller.ts`
- `src/articles/` — `articles.module.ts`, `.service.ts`, `.controller.ts`, `dto/create-article.dto.ts`, `dto/update-article.dto.ts`, `dto/list-articles.query.ts`
- `src/comments/` — `comments.module.ts`, `.service.ts`, `.controller.ts`, `dto/create-comment.dto.ts`
- `src/tags/tags.module.ts`, `tags.controller.ts`, `tags.service.ts`
- `src/common/slug.util.ts` — `slugify(title)` + collision-safe suffix
- `test/conduit.e2e-spec.ts`

**Client (`client/`)**
- `package.json`, `angular.json`, `tsconfig*.json`, `src/index.html`, `src/main.ts`, `src/styles.css`
- `src/app/app.config.ts` — `provideRouter(routes, withComponentInputBinding())`, `provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([authInterceptor]))`
- `src/app/app.routes.ts`, `src/app/app.component.ts`
- `src/app/core/` — `api.service.ts`, `auth.service.ts` (signal-based `currentUser`), `auth.interceptor.ts`, `auth.guard.ts`, `models.ts`
- `src/app/layout/header.component.ts`, `footer.component.ts`
- `src/app/pages/home/home.component.ts` — feed tabs + tag sidebar, driven by query params
- `src/app/pages/auth/login.component.ts`, `register.component.ts`
- `src/app/pages/article/article.component.ts`, `comment-list.component.ts`
- `src/app/pages/editor/editor.component.ts`
- `src/app/pages/profile/profile.component.ts` (+ child route for favorites)
- `src/app/pages/settings/settings.component.ts`
- `src/app/shared/article-preview.component.ts`, `favorite-button.component.ts`, `follow-button.component.ts`, `pagination.component.ts`, `confirm-modal.component.ts`
- `e2e/smoke.spec.ts` — Playwright assertion of the 4 acceptance markers

### Dependencies
- **Server:** `@nestjs/{common,core,platform-express,config,jwt,passport,serve-static}`, `passport`, `passport-jwt`, `@prisma/client`, `prisma` (dev), `bcryptjs`, `class-validator`, `class-transformer`, `slugify`
- **Client:** `@angular/{core,common,router,forms,platform-browser}` `^20`, `rxjs`, `zone.js`
- **Infra:** `postgres:16`, `node:20-alpine`

### Integrations
None — the spec declares no third-party services.

### Assumptions
1. **Greenfield.** No stack config exists; the spec's stated stack (NestJS + Prisma/Postgres + Angular + JWT) is authoritative.
2. **Auth model is `full_auth` with public reads.** Spec scenarios explicitly grant *visitors* the home page, global feed, tag sidebar, articles and profiles. Guarded routes: `/editor`, `/editor/:slug`, `/settings`. Public: `/`, `/login`, `/register`, `/article/:slug`, `/profile/:username`, `/api/health*`. No admin role exists in the spec, so none is built and no first-user-is-admin rule applies.
3. **`@IsEmail({ require_tld: false })`** on all email DTOs — the seeded `jake@demo` is otherwise rejected. Non-negotiable.
4. **JWT extractor accepts both `Bearer <jwt>` and `Token <jwt>`** — RealWorld convention is `Token`; the spec says only "JWT". Supporting both removes the guess.
5. **Single container.** Nest serves the SPA from `public/` with an SPA fallback. No CORS, one URL for the oracle.
6. **Angular 20**, standalone components, zone-based change detection. v22's zoneless-by-default + Vitest defaults add build risk with no spec benefit.
7. **Slug** = `slugify(title, {lower:true, strict:true})` plus a 6-char base36 suffix on collision.
8. **Pagination** = `limit=10, offset=0`, exposed as `?page=`.
9. Seed is `upsert`-based and safe to re-run on every boot.

## Implementation Plan

### Step 1: Monorepo scaffold
**Files:** root configs, `client/`, `server/`
**Change:** Create the two workspaces, `.gitignore`, `.dockerignore`, `.env.example` (`DATABASE_URL`, `JWT_SECRET`, `PORT=3000`). Root `package.json` with `build`, `dev`, `test` scripts delegating to each workspace.

### Step 2: Prisma schema and migration
**File:** `server/prisma/schema.prisma`
**Change:** Model exactly the spec's Data Model. `User` (unique `username`, `email`; `bio`, `image` nullable). `Article` (unique `slug`, `authorId` FK, `createdAt`/`updatedAt`). `Comment` (FK `articleId` cascade-delete, `authorId`). `Tag` (unique `name`). `ArticleTag` (composite PK, cascade). `Favorite` (composite PK `[userId, articleId]`, cascade). `Follow` (composite PK `[followerId, followedId]`, self-relation with named back-refs). Generate the initial migration.

### Step 3: Prisma service + health endpoints
**Files:** `server/src/prisma/*`, `server/src/health/health.controller.ts`
**Change:** `PrismaService extends PrismaClient` with `onModuleInit` connect; global module. `/api/health` returns `{status:'ok'}` with no DB touch (liveness); `/api/health/deep` runs `$queryRaw\`SELECT 1\`` and returns 503 on failure (readiness). Both public.

### Step 4: Auth module
**Files:** `server/src/auth/*`
**Change:**
- `POST /api/users` — register: uniqueness check on username/email → 409; bcrypt hash (10 rounds); returns `{user:{email,token,username,bio,image}}`.
- `POST /api/users/login` — verify with `bcrypt.compare`; 401 on failure.
- `GET /api/user` / `PUT /api/user` — guarded; PUT re-hashes password only when supplied.
- `JwtStrategy`: `jwtFromRequest` = custom extractor reading the `Authorization` header and accepting `Bearer` or `Token`. Payload `{sub, username}`; `validate` loads the user, throws `UnauthorizedException` if absent.
- `OptionalJwtAuthGuard extends AuthGuard('jwt')` overriding `handleRequest` to return `null` instead of throwing — used on public read endpoints so `favorited`/`following` flags reflect the viewer.
- **DTO validation uses `@IsEmail({ require_tld: false })`** (Assumption 3).

### Step 5: Profiles + follows
**Files:** `server/src/profiles/*`
**Change:** `GET /api/profiles/:username` (optional auth → `following` flag). `POST`/`DELETE /api/profiles/:username/follow` (guarded; 401 unauthenticated). Self-follow → 400. Create/delete uses the composite key so repeats are idempotent.

### Step 6: Articles module
**Files:** `server/src/articles/*`, `server/src/common/slug.util.ts`
**Change:**
- `GET /api/articles?tag=&author=&favorited=&limit=&offset=` — optional auth, `orderBy createdAt desc`, returns `{articles, articlesCount}`.
- `GET /api/articles/feed` — guarded; articles by followed authors only.
- `GET /api/articles/:slug` — optional auth.
- `POST /api/articles` — guarded; slugify title, `connectOrCreate` each tag, link via `ArticleTag`.
- `PUT`/`DELETE /api/articles/:slug` — guarded; **load the article first and throw `ForbiddenException` (403) if `authorId !== currentUser.id`**, before any mutation. Re-slug on title change.
- `POST`/`DELETE /api/articles/:slug/favorite` — guarded; toggles `Favorite`, response carries recomputed `favoritesCount`.
- Shared `toArticleDto(article, viewerId)` mapper emitting `tagList`, `favorited`, `favoritesCount`, and nested `author` profile.

### Step 7: Comments + tags
**Files:** `server/src/comments/*`, `server/src/tags/*`
**Change:** `GET /api/articles/:slug/comments` (optional auth), `POST` (guarded), `DELETE /api/articles/:slug/comments/:id` (guarded; 403 unless the requester authored the comment; 404 if it belongs to a different article). Comments carry `createdAt` and the author profile. `GET /api/tags` returns tag names ordered by usage count descending, powering "Popular Tags".

### Step 8: Static serving + bootstrap
**Files:** `server/src/app.module.ts`, `server/src/main.ts`
**Change:** `app.setGlobalPrefix('api')`, global `ValidationPipe`, listen on `0.0.0.0:$PORT`. `ServeStaticModule.forRoot({ rootPath: join(__dirname,'..','public'), exclude: ['/api/{*path}'] })` — **note the Express 5 wildcard syntax required by NestJS 11; the legacy `'/api*'` form throws at boot.**

### Step 9: Seed script
**File:** `server/prisma/seed.ts`
**Change:** `upsert` jake (`jake@demo`, bcrypt of `Demo1234!`, bio `"I work at statefarm"`), `upsert` tags `dragons` and `training`, `upsert` article `"How to train your dragon"` (slug `how-to-train-your-dragon`, description + body), link both tags, and `upsert` one comment on it. Idempotent — safe on every container start.

### Step 10: Angular shell, routing and marker-safe index
**Files:** `client/src/index.html`, `app.config.ts`, `app.routes.ts`, `app.component.ts`, `layout/header.component.ts`
**Change:** `index.html` gets `<title>Conduit</title>` and **static pre-boot markup inside `<app-root>` containing "Conduit", "Global Feed" and "Popular Tags"**, so a raw-HTML marker grep succeeds regardless of JS execution (Risk 1). Header renders the `conduit` brand, and — via the `currentUser` signal — either Sign in/Sign up or New Article/Settings/`jake`.

Routes, each with a `data.flow` node:
| Path | Guard | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `/` | — | `?feed=global\|your`, `?tag=`, `?page=` |
| `/login`, `/register` | — | |
| `/article/:slug` | — | `?modal=confirm-delete` |
| `/profile/:username` | — | child: `''` (articles) and `favorites` |
| `/editor`, `/editor/:slug` | `authGuard` | |
| `/settings` | `authGuard` | |
| `**` | — | 404 → redirect `/` |

`authGuard` redirects to `/login?returnUrl=`.

### Step 11: Core client services
**Files:** `client/src/app/core/*`
**Change:** `AuthService` persists the JWT in `localStorage`, exposes a `currentUser` signal, hydrates via `GET /api/user` on boot. `authInterceptor` attaches `Authorization: Token <jwt>` when present and clears session + redirects to `/login` on a 401. `ApiService` wraps the endpoints and unwraps RealWorld envelopes.

### Step 12: Home page
**File:** `client/src/app/pages/home/home.component.ts`
**Change:** Banner reading **"conduit"**. Tabs: **"Global Feed"** always, **"Your Feed"** only when authenticated, plus a **`#dragons`** tab when `?tag=` is set. All tab/tag/page state lives in query params and is restored on load, so every view is deep-linkable. Sidebar headed **"Popular Tags"** from `GET /api/tags`; clicking one navigates to `/?tag=<name>`. Renders `ArticlePreviewComponent` per article.

### Step 13: Article, editor, profile, settings pages
**Files:** `client/src/app/pages/{article,editor,profile,settings}/*`
**Change:** Article page shows title, body, tags, author, favorite/follow buttons, and Edit/Delete only for the author — delete opens `?modal=confirm-delete`. Comment form appears for authenticated users, sign-in prompt otherwise; each comment shows author, timestamp, and a delete control for its own author. Editor is a reactive form for create and edit, redirecting to the article on save and surfacing server validation errors. Profile shows username, bio, image, follow button, and the My Articles / Favorited Articles child routes. Settings updates the profile and logs out.

### Step 14: Docker, entrypoint, k8s
**Files:** `Dockerfile`, `docker-entrypoint.sh`, `docker-compose.yml`, `k8s/*`
**Change:** Stage 1 `npm ci && npm run build` in `client/` → `dist/conduit/browser`. Stage 2 `npm ci`, `prisma generate`, `npm run build` in `server/`. Stage 3 `node:20-alpine`: copy `server/dist`, production `node_modules`, `prisma/`, and stage 1's output into `public/`. Entrypoint runs `migrate deploy` → seed → `node dist/main.js`. Deployment mounts `DATABASE_URL`/`JWT_SECRET` from a Secret; probes hit `/api/health` and `/api/health/deep`.

### Step 15: Tests
**Files:** `server/test/conduit.e2e-spec.ts`, `client/e2e/smoke.spec.ts`
**Change:** API e2e: register → login → create article → verify it appears in the global feed and under its tag → comment → favorite → follow; assert **401** for each unauthenticated write and **403** when a second user edits or deletes jake's article. Playwright smoke asserts all four acceptance markers render on `/`.

## Testing Strategy
- `docker compose up` → `curl localhost:3000/api/health` and `/api/health/deep` return 200.
- `curl -s localhost:3000/ | grep -c "Conduit"` > 0 (validates the Step 10 pre-boot markup).
- Load `/` in a browser: "Conduit", "Global Feed", "How to train your dragon", "Popular Tags" all visible.
- Sign in as `jake@demo` / `Demo1234!` → header shows `jake`. **This is the single highest-value manual check — it is what catches the `IsEmail` TLD landmine.**
- Click `dragons` in the sidebar → URL becomes `/?tag=dragons`, list filters. Reload → state restored.
- Register a second user; confirm 403 when editing jake's article and 401 for writes with the token stripped.
- `npm run test:e2e` in `server/`, `npx playwright test` in `client/`.

## Risks
- **Marker grep vs. SPA.** If the acceptance oracle greps raw HTML rather than the rendered DOM, an ordinary Angular SPA fails all four markers. Step 10's static `<app-root>` content is the mitigation and must not be removed as "dead markup".
- **`jake@demo` fails default `@IsEmail()`.** Login returns 400 and the seeded-author scenario fails outright. Every email DTO needs `{ require_tld: false }`.
- **NestJS 11 / Express 5 wildcards.** `exclude: ['/api*']` throws a path-to-regexp error at boot; the `'/api/{*path}'` form is required.
- **403 vs. 401 conflation.** Guard-only ownership enforcement yields 401 where the spec demands 403. The ownership check must be an explicit `ForbiddenException` inside the service.
- **Migration/seed race.** Multiple replicas running `migrate deploy` concurrently can conflict — deploy with `replicas: 1` and `strategy: Recreate` initially.
- **Prisma 6 generator deprecation.** `prisma-client-js` without an explicit `output` warns; harmless in v6, but pin `prisma`/`@prisma/client` to the same `^6.x` minor to avoid drift into v7's changed default.
- **Slug collisions** on duplicate titles — the base36 suffix handles this, but the unique constraint must be caught and retried rather than surfacing a 500.

Sources: [Angular latest version 2026](https://frontendminds.com/blog/angular-latest-version-2026), [Prisma changelog](https://www.prisma.io/changelog), [Prisma 6 upgrade guide](https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/more/upgrade-guides/upgrading-versions/upgrading-to-prisma-6)
